title: Simulation space bound
statement: For natural numbers $A,n,W,f$ and a function $S_W : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$, define the simulation space to be $S_W(n)+A\bigl(f(W+1)+W+\operatorname{Complexity.logSpace}(n)+1\bigr)$, where $\operatorname{Complexity.logSpace}(n)$ denotes the logarithmic space quantity associated with input size $n$.
caveat: The supplied snippet does not include a mathematical description of $\operatorname{Complexity.logSpace}$, so its meaning cannot be made fully self-contained from the provided definitions.
